events.title: Club Leadership Bootcamp 2025
events.description:
"Leadership is unlocking people's potential to become better." – Bill Bradley

On October 10, 2024, during the Club Leadership Bootcamp 2025, the environment was filled with inspiration and purpose. Our panel members from BRAC University Cultural Club (BUCuC) attended an empowering session titled **"Unlocking Opportunities."**

The session became even more impactful with the honorable presence of Vice Chancellor **Professor Syed Ferhat Anwar, PhD**, Registrar **Dr. David Dowland**, Joint Director of Student Life **Ms. Tahsina Rahman**, and officials from Student Life. Their words of encouragement motivated our members to develop as future leaders.

The session highlighted how leadership grows through recognizing possibilities, embracing challenges, and inspiring collective growth. It was a reminder that true leadership begins with unlocking the potential within ourselves and others.

Heartfelt thanks to the Office of Co-curricular Activities (OCA) and Student Life for organizing such a transformative and empowering experience. Work. Bond. Glow. ✨

BUCuC panel members attended the Club Leadership Bootcamp 2025.
Insightful session on **"Unlocking Opportunities"** focused on leadership and personal development.
Honorable Vice Chancellor, Registrar, and Student Life officials graced the session.
Key ideas included recognizing potential, embracing challenges, and inspiring growth.
Organized by the Office of Co-curricular Activities (OCA) and Student Life.
A meaningful step forward in shaping BUCuC's future leaders.

events.title: Participation at 16th Convocation Volunteers Appreciation Ceremony
events.description: "Volunteers are the gentle light that makes every celebration shine brighter." On 8th August, at the peaceful BRAC University Residential Campus in Savar, we came together to honor the incredible volunteers who devoted their time and energy to making the 16th Convocation a success. Their tireless efforts stood at the heart of the celebration. The event grew even more meaningful with the presence of our Honorable Vice-Chancellor, Registrar, and Co-Chairman, who expressed their gratitude and personally handed each volunteer a certificate of appreciation. BUCuC felt truly privileged to perform on this special occasion—pouring our respect into soulful music, expressive dance, and heartfelt qawwali. To all the volunteers who brought warmth, dedication, and love to one of the most important days of the year: thank you for making it unforgettable. Work. Bond. Glow. ✨

events.title: বৈশাখী উৎসব ১৪৩২
events.place: BRAC University Multipupose Hall & Open Space
events.description:
Boishakh — a season of light, color, and renewal.
BRAC University welcomed **Bengali New Year 1432** with a campus transformed into a vibrant canvas of celebration.

The day began with a joyful Boishakhi procession bright smiles, colorful portraits, and hearts full of festive spirit. Under the banyan tree, music and rhythm set the perfect tone, followed by traditional village games and a lively flash mob that spread the energy of Boishakh across campus.

Evening brought an enchanting cultural program — folk songs, graceful dances, and heartfelt recitations reflecting the soul of Bengal. The **Boishakhi fair** offered traditional foods, handicrafts, and the colors of Bengal in every detail, from sarees and panjabis to intricate alpana designs.

More than just a day, this Boishakh was a heartfelt celebration of culture, heritage, and beauty. The BRAC University Cultural Club warmly thanks everyone who made it truly memorable.
events.highlights:
Vibrant Boishakhi procession with colorful portraits and smiles
Traditional music and rhythms under the banyan tree
Village games reconnecting with Bengal's roots
Energetic flash mob spreading festive cheer
Enchanting evening of folk songs, dances, and recitations
Boishakhi fair with traditional food, crafts, and alpana art

events.title: Participation at Wild Escape by BUAC
events.description:
**The Wild Escape—A Magical Finale to a Remarkable Journey!**

On 17 April, 2025, Brac University Adventure Club's thrilling two-day extravaganza came to a spectacular end. The final day carried an electric excitement—an atmosphere filled with glowing faces, proud achievements, and a sense of celebration that could be felt in every corner.

The energy reached its peak during the vibrant award ceremony. Laughter, applause, and satisfaction rippled through the crowd as participants were recognized for their spirit and dedication throughout the adventure. It was a moment that beautifully captured the heart of the event.

Then came the highlight of the evening—BRAC University Cultural Club stepped onto the stage and transformed it completely. With mesmerizing music and dynamic dance performances, our talented artists infused the venue with rhythmic passion, cultural richness, and contagious enthusiasm. Their performance became the radiant cultural finale, lifting the entire event to its highest and most magical point.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to every performer who poured their soul into the stage, to the Adventure Club for organizing such a seamless and spirited event, and to the energetic audience whose cheers lit up the day. Together, we created memories that will be cherished for years to come, strengthened meaningful bonds, and celebrated the extraordinary blend of adventure and art.

What a beautiful moment of unity, pride, and glowing brilliance. Work. Bond. Glow. ✨ Keep your eyes open—more dazzling BUCuC showcases are on the way, ready to shine even brighter.

events.title: BUCuC Iftar 2025
events.description:
March 10th at BRAC University wasn't just another evening—it was a reunion of hearts. The BRAC University Cultural Club gathered for their Iftar Mahfil, where Mentors, the current Panel, and General Members came together under one roof.

As the sky blushed with sunset, the call to prayer signaled the moment everyone had been waiting for. Dates were shared, water poured, and laughter mingled with the aroma of iftar. It was a table not just of food, but of friendship and memories.

The celebrations didn't end there. A surprise birthday for General Secretary Nafisa Noor turned the room into a whirlwind of cheers and cake. Then came the BUCuC signature—an impromptu jamming session. Guitars, claps, and voices rose in unison, creating a soundtrack for the night.

In those few hours, nostalgia met new memories, and BUCuC's spirit shone brighter than ever.

events.title: Panel 2025-26 Handover
events.description:
It was a day of change, emotion, and promise for BRAC University Cultural Club – BUCuC.
On 11th February 2025, the campus buzzed with anticipation as members gathered to witness a special chapter unfold. The event opened with the outgoing 2024-2025 panel taking the stage, their voices carrying both pride and nostalgia. They looked back on the laughter, challenges, and triumphs that had shaped their journey, leaving the audience touched by their heartfelt words.

Then came the moment everyone was waiting for — the unveiling of the 2025-2026 panel. With bright eyes and bold visions, the new leaders shared their plans to carry BUCuC into an exciting future. The atmosphere brimmed with applause and encouragement as dedicated ASBs and SBs were promoted, each recognition met with warm smiles and cheers.

Speeches followed — not just from the panel, but from SBs themselves — weaving dreams of unity, creativity, and growth. By the end of the day, it wasn’t just an event; it was a passing of the torch, a celebration of achievements, and the start of a brand-new journey.

Then, as if guided by tradition, the BUCuC jamming session began. Guitars strummed, voices rose, and even the Mentors joined in, creating a wave of rhythm and harmony that carried the night forward. Music spilled into every corner, blending past and present into a single, timeless moment.

It was more than just an event—it was a living portrait of BUCuC’s spirit: **WORK. BOND. GLOW.**

events.title: Rythm Revive 24.0
events.description:
As the curtain closed on the 2023–25 Presidential Panel of BUCuC, we gathered for a two-day celebration filled with nostalgia, artistry, energy, and heartfelt emotion. **Rhythm Revive 24.0** was not just a farewell — it was a tribute to creativity, unity, and the unforgettable legacy we built together. Months of rehearsals, planning, and shared dreams culminated in two nights of pure magic.

**✨ Day 1: The Show of Hearts — A Journey into Classical Thumri**

The first day belonged entirely to our members — a vibrant mosaic of dance, music, drama, and expressive storytelling. The highlight of the evening was a breathtaking **30-minute classical live-music and dance Thumri**, a performance crafted from months of passion, persistence, and artistic discipline.

**The Thumri Performance** brought together lyrical poetry, emotional nuance, and live improvisation — blending classical melody with expressive movement. Our dancers — *Nafisa Noor, Shemonti, Poroma, Mitisha, Diana, Arora, Faiza, and Mansura* — embodied the essence of longing, devotion, and storytelling through graceful expressions and synchronized choreography.

Behind them, our musicians built the emotional landscape:

**Vocal & Harmonium:** Avibadhan Das

**Tabla:** Aparup Chowdhury

**Cajon & Darbuka:** Ayam Dhar

**Benjo:** Andalib Mostafa Lalon

**Guitar:** Almas Ovi, Shafawath Alam

**Keyboard:** Farhan Ishraq

**Dholok:** Imtiaz Salam Jami

**Bass:** Tahmid Rayan

For half an hour, music and movement merged into a shared heartbeat — a farewell gift to our outgoing leaders and a testament to BUCuC’s artistic soul.

**✨ Day 2: The Light, Energy & Farewell Concert**

Day 2 embraced a vibrant shift — from classical depth to youthful energy. Bands took the stage, filling the night with rhythm and celebration. The grand finale featured beloved artists: **Level Five** and **Indalo**, whose performances ignited cheers, nostalgia, and the emotion of closing an era.

Through music and memory, they connected our past, present, and future — reminding us of the journey that shaped us.

**A Farewell, A Legacy, A New Beginning**

This two-day festival was not just an ending — it was a celebration of dreams fulfilled, challenges overcome, and friendships forged through art. To the Presidential Panel of 2023–25: your leadership guided us toward this unforgettable chapter. And to every performer, musician, dancer, organizer, and volunteer — you transformed vision into reality.

As we turn the page, we welcome a new beginning. May the spirit of Rhythm Revive inspire the next generation to shine even brighter.

**Because BUCuC is not just a club — it’s a legacy.**

**Work. Bond. Glow.** ✨

Day 2 was a high-energy concert with performances from multiple bands.
Grand finale by Level Five and Indalo.
A celebration of unity, creativity, and the enduring spirit of BUCuC.

events.title: A Magical Qawali Night at AquaVenture: Club Fair Fall ’24 ✨
events.description:
The BRAC University Multipurpose Hall transformed into a space of pure musical enchantment as BRAC University Cultural Club (BUCuC) presented a soul-stirring Qawali performance at “AquaVenture: Club Fair Fall ’24,” proudly organized by BRAC University Adventure Club (BUAC). What was expected to be a regular club fair showcase soon turned into a transcendent experience—one that left the entire audience mesmerized.

Despite a slight delay, the excitement never faded. In fact, anticipation only grew stronger. Students filled every corner of the hall—standing, sitting on the floor, leaning against the walls—waiting eagerly for BUCuC’s Qawali segment. And the moment the first chord touched the air, the atmosphere shifted. It felt magical.

**A Performance That Touched Hearts**

The 20-minute performance flowed like a spiritual journey through timeless classics—*“Yeh Jo Halka Halka Suroor,” “Kali Kali Zulfon,”* and *“Kun Faya Kun.”* The true magic unfolded when the crowd began to sing along, their voices merging with the performers in a unified chorus filled with devotion, nostalgia, and serenity. For a moment, the entire hall shared the same heartbeat.

What filled the space was more than music—it was peace, warmth, and a sense of togetherness that only heartfelt Qawali can create. Many later said it was one of the most memorable musical moments they had experienced at BRAC University.

**The Artists Behind the Magic**

BUCuC’s finest performers came together to craft this unforgettable evening:

**Main Vocal:** Avibadhan Das
**Chorus:** Meer Abrar Ahmad & Partho
**Tabla:** Aparup Chowdhury
**Kahon:** Ayam Niloy
**Guitar 1:** Meer Abrar Ahmad
**Guitar 2:** Partho Protim Haldar
**Keyboard:** Farhan Ishraq
**Bass:** Sayeed Imam
**Percussion:** Habib Hasan

Each artist added a unique layer—rich vocals, rhythmic tabla strokes, soothing guitar lines, entrancing percussion, and harmonies that wrapped the hall in mystique. Together, they created a soundscape that felt almost divine.

**A Night to Remember**

The Qawali night at AquaVenture was more than a performance—it was a shared emotional experience, a celebration of culture, and a beautiful reminder of the power of music to connect and heal. BUCuC once again proved its ability to create magic on stage, leaving every listener touched by the moment.

The hall eventually emptied, but the feeling stayed. For everyone who witnessed it, this night will remain one of the most unforgettable musical highlights of Club Fair Fall ’24.
